definitions.aggregation_unit: Len_Que: individual question; all other metrics: project; each visible immediate subdirectory is one project
definitions.text_length: UTF-8 text split on whitespace; all content including headings and answer choices is counted
definitions.Len_Intro: total introduction.txt word count in each project
definitions.Len_Que: word count of each individual questionN.txt; Mean, Max and Min across all individual questions, Total across all question words
definitions.#Questions: number of files matching question[0-9]+.txt, not the largest question number
definitions.#Excel: all .xlsx, .xlsm and .xlsb files, including auxiliary workbooks
definitions.Excel Size (KB): sum of Excel file sizes in bytes / 1024 per project
definitions.#Image: standalone image files; excludes images embedded in Excel
definitions.#Sheets: all Excel worksheets, including hidden worksheets; excludes chart sheets
definitions.ignored_files: hidden files and hidden directories, including .DS_Store
